breakdown.description: The RuntimeError check reuses the same valid defect-state configuration used for the normal SRH-coefficient calculation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly creates an invalid defect configuration by modifying `defect.charge = 1` (or any non-neutral integer) before attempting the RuntimeError-triggering call. This directly addresses the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt reused the same valid defect-state configuration. The generated spec correctly distinguishes between the valid configuration used for normal SRH coefficient calculation and an invalidated configuration used for the RuntimeError check.
